task_result.prompt: I made a landing page HTML file with ChatGPT. How can I publish it online for free with a real URL?
task_result.result_text:
Publish it with a free static hosting service that provides a real URL. Options include:
- Netlify Drop or Netlify (free tier) — upload your index.html and get a live URL.
- HTMLPub or HTML Launch-style services — paste HTML and get a shareable URL.
- Tiiny.host or static hosting services that give a live link from a file upload.
- FYLO or MakeMySiteLive-style hosts — paste HTML or upload ZIP to receive a public URL.

Steps (typical):
- Copy your HTML code from ChatGPT.
- Choose a free hosting option and either paste the HTML into a editor or upload the HTML file (often as index.html) or a ZIP.
- Publish or deploy to receive a live URL you can share.

Examples you can try:
- Netlify Drop: drag and drop index.html, get a live URL instantly (free tier).
- HTMLPub: paste HTML, get a live URL like htmlpub.com/p/your-page-slug.
- Tiiny.host: drag file or ZIP, get a link (free tier limits small sites).

If you want, tell me which option you prefer (drag-and-drop, paste-and-publish, or a specific service), and I’ll give precise steps.
